name: Neo Brutalist
signature: Mint page, 4px black borders, hard shadows, mono headings, sticker labels.

contrast.note: Mint page, black text. Orange is a fill color only (buttons, stickers), never text on the page. Black labels on orange pass AA.

type.eyebrow: 0.8125rem, mono, weight 700, uppercase, inside a 3px black-bordered label

motion.rule: Pop: elements scale from 0.92 to full size in 350ms with a 40ms stagger, and the sticker label tilts with the pointer.

hero.layout: Oversized mono headline on the mint page, a 4px black-bordered photo frame rotated 2deg with a hard shadow, and an orange sticker label rotated -3deg ("Open Saturdays" only if true). Buttons are stacked, full width on mobile.
hero.photo: Real photo inside the bordered frame.

background: Flat mint. Every card, image and button gets a 4px black border and a hard offset shadow. No gradients, no blur, no textures.

button.fill: Accent fill, black label, 4px black border, 5px offset black shadow.
button.label: Mono, weight 700, uppercase, 0.02em tracking.
button.hover: Press moves the button 3px down-right with data-press; shadow stays put.

banned: pastel colors beyond the page background
